sections.heading: India
sections.body: Reo Enterprise handles account and reading information under the Information Technology Act, 2000 and its Reasonable Security Practices and Sensitive Personal Data or Information Rules, 2011. Passwords are stored only as protected hashes. You can review, correct or ask us to delete your information, or withdraw consent for future processing, by writing to sales@reoenterprise.org. Ronik Basak, Chief of Operations, is the Grievance Officer and responds to grievances within one month. As the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules commence, Earnalism will apply them, including any parental-consent requirement for readers under 18.

sections.heading: United States
sections.body: In the United States, Earnalism accounts are for people aged 18 or older; we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13, and we delete it if we learn we have. We do not sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising, and we do not use advertising trackers. Residents of states with consumer privacy laws can ask to access, correct or delete their information at sales@reoenterprise.org.

sections.heading: United Kingdom (UK GDPR)
sections.body: Reo Enterprise is the controller. We process account and reading information to provide the service you sign up for (contract), to keep it secure (legitimate interests) and where you consent. In the UK, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You have rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port and object to processing; write to sales@reoenterprise.org. Information is processed outside the UK by our hosting providers under their data-processing terms. You can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).

sections.heading: Brazil (LGPD)
sections.body: Reo Enterprise is the controller under the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Law 13.709/2018). We process account and reading information to perform the service you request, for security, and with your consent where asked. In Brazil, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You can confirm processing, access, correct, anonymise or delete data, request portability, obtain information about sharing, and withdraw consent (Art. 18). Encarregado (data protection contact): sales@reoenterprise.org. Information is transferred internationally to our hosting providers under their data-processing terms (Art. 33). You can complain to the ANPD (gov.br/anpd).

sections.heading: Singapore (PDPA)
sections.body: We collect, use and disclose personal data under the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 for the account and reading purposes described above, with your consent given at signup. In Singapore, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You may request access to or correction of your personal data and withdraw consent. Data Protection Officer: sales@reoenterprise.org. Our hosting providers in Singapore and elsewhere protect transferred data to a comparable standard under their terms.

sections.heading: Malaysia (PDPA)
sections.body: We process personal data under the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 for the account and reading purposes described above, with your consent. In Malaysia, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You may request access to and correction of your personal data, withdraw consent, and ask about disclosures. Contact our data protection contact at sales@reoenterprise.org. Personal data is transferred to our hosting providers outside Malaysia under their data-processing terms.

sections.heading: Indonesia (PDP Law)
sections.body: We process personal data under Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection for the account and reading purposes described above, with your consent. In Indonesia, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You may access, correct, update, obtain a copy of and delete your personal data, withdraw consent and object to processing. Contact: sales@reoenterprise.org. Personal data is transferred to our hosting providers outside Indonesia under their data-processing terms.

sections.heading: Philippines (Data Privacy Act)
sections.body: We process personal information under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 for the account and reading purposes described above, with your consent. In the Philippines, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You have the rights to be informed, to access, to object, to erasure or blocking, to rectification, to data portability and to damages. Data Protection Officer: sales@reoenterprise.org. You can complain to the National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph).

sections.heading: Thailand (PDPA)
sections.body: We process personal data under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) for the account and reading purposes described above, with your consent. In Thailand, accounts are for people aged 18 or older. You may access, obtain a copy of, port, object to, delete, restrict and correct your personal data, and withdraw consent. Contact: sales@reoenterprise.org. You can complain to the Personal Data Protection Committee (pdpc.or.th).
